correctness.rationale: For a finite positive nested chain the superlevel sets determine the stated concentric rearrangement. Linearity and \(L^1\)-integrability reduce the energy comparison to the Euclidean triangle inequality. The published ball formula makes concentric gradients positively collinear and makes distinct-center gradients noncollinear almost everywhere when \(N\ge2\), while in \(N=1\) two distinct centers give an interval of opposite radial directions. Hence the deficit is nonnegative and vanishes exactly for a common center. Exceptional centers and sphere boundaries are null sets.
